'''Hanthor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] serving the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] in [[3638 BBY]]. He was promoted to his current position after the reforms enacted after [[Darth Malgus]]'s coup, wishing to set an example for his people and serve them through the Empire. He earned his rank due to his actions during the [[Battle of Ilum (Great Galactic War)|Battle of Ilum]]: he pulled a gun on his fellow Cathar to prevent them defecting to the [[New Empire]]. His loyalty was recognized, earning the respect of even some of the more xenophobic of the imperial military, and he was promoted. He was part of the support team for the Imperial strike force during the [[Conquest of Makeb]], along with [[Katha Niar]], [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Cytharat]], [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Bedareux]] and [[Nadrin Tro]]. Monitoring [[Makeb]] communications and holonet channels, Hanthor also expressed interests in other Makeb operations, including a former [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] operative and a group of five mercenaries who might damage Imperial interests known as the [[Specialists]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Hanthor first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', a digital expansion released in [[2012]] for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.

Despite being introduced during the main storyline, Hanthor can be seen outside of the main story phases, and players are able to accept missions about other Makeb interests.
